scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run dev -w @nicerp/api" "npm run dev -w @nicerp/web"
scripts.build: npm run db:generate && npm run build -w @nicerp/api && npm run build -w @nicerp/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run db:generate && npm run typecheck --workspaces
scripts.test:business: npm run db:generate && npm run build -w @nicerp/api && node --env-file=apps/api/.env scripts/test-business.mjs
scripts.test:browser: npm run build -w @nicerp/web && BROWSER_TEST=1 npm run test:business
